## LEDGER

**(a) Obligations**

| ob | phrase | status | closers |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OB-1** VIOLATOR — *torn down, rebuilt with the same identity, comes back wearing its predecessor's state* | CLOSED | `xyflow packages/system/src/utils/store.ts` (adoptUserNodes: `tmpLookup.get(userNode.id)` → `parseHandles(userNode, internalNode)` hands the **previous** node's measured `handleBounds`/`z`/`positionAbsolute` to a brand-new node purely because the id string matched); `jotai src/vanilla/utils/atomFamily.ts` (`atoms: Map<Param,[AtomType,CreatedAt]>` — the atom, with all its state, is returned for any later call with an equal param, with nothing tying its life to the subject's); `table packages/table-core/src/utils/getCoreRowModel.ts` (row model memoised on `[table.options.data]`, `rowsById` rebuilt by id) |
| **OB-2** the dual failure — *two distinct things handed one shared entry, quietly overwriting each other* | CLOSED | `zod packages/zod/src/v4/core/registries.ts:39-41` (`this._idmap.set(meta.id!, schema)` — a second schema registered under the same `id` silently replaces the first, and that strong `Map` entry outlives the schema the `WeakMap` half correctly releases); `table packages/table-core/src/utils/getCoreRowModel.ts:32-53` (`rowModel.rowsById[row.id] = row`, with the dev-only duplicate/missing-id throw commented out at lines 32-37); `xyflow packages/system/src/utils/store.ts` (`nodeLookup.set(userNode.id, …)` — last node with a given id wins) |
| **OB-3** OWNER — *the rule about when remembered work must be let go* | CLOSED | `query packages/query-core/src/removable.ts:6-40` (`Removable`: `gcTime` → `scheduleGc` → `optionalRemove`, the only thing that ends a cache entry's life); `tldraw packages/store/src/lib/Store.ts:1104-1155` (`createCache` keys a `WeakCache<Atom,…>` on the **record's atom**, not its id — "cleans up when records are deleted", lines 131-132); `tldraw packages/store/src/lib/AtomMap.ts:247-298` (`delete`/`deleteMany` drop the atom, so a re-created record gets a *new* atom and no inherited derivation); `tldraw packages/utils/src/lib/cache.ts` (`WeakCache<K extends object,V>` — the weak-keyed mechanism both rely on); `jotai src/vanilla/utils/atomFamily.ts:125-151` (`remove`/`setShouldRemove` — the let-go rule, but manual and time-based, never tied to the subject) |
| **OB-4** OWNER — *equal keys may not be assumed to mean the same subject* | CLOSED | `reselect src/devModeChecks/cacheSizeCheck.ts:11-44` — states the contract verbatim: results keyed by **objects** live in `WeakMap`s and are released once the key is unreachable; results keyed by **primitives** (ids, offsets, page numbers) are held strongly and "only released by `clearCache()`"; `jotai src/vanilla/utils/atomFamily.ts:80-90` (`areEqual === undefined` → `atoms.get(param)`: equal key ⇒ same subject); `table packages/table-core/src/core/row.ts:104-152` (the in-repo counterexample — `_valuesCache`/`_uniqueValuesCache` are created per `createRow`, so their lifetime *is* the row's) |

**(b) Sweep matrix** — repositories in SWEPT, per obligation

| ob | repos swept |
|---|---|
| OB-1 | table, xyflow, tldraw, router, jotai, reselect, zustand, react, react-redux, redux-devtools |
| OB-2 | table, xyflow, zod, redux-toolkit, db, zustand, primitives, redux |
| OB-3 | query, db, jotai, reselect, redux-toolkit, router, tldraw, redux-devtools |
| OB-4 | reselect, zod, table, jotai, react, db, primitives, redux |

Every row meets or exceeds its ob's `repos[]` length; all 16 roster repositories were scoped into at least once. Commit discipline held: `redux`, `react`, `table`, `zustand` were queried at their ROSTER pins, not their newer indexed tips. Two opening `stakeout` results exceeded the return cap and were read from the files the tool handed back.
